{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
# The value -999.0 appears in biomarker_baseline
print("Rows with sentinel value -999 in baseline:", trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999].shape[0])

# Check if -999 appears in final biomarker
print("Rows with sentinel value -999 in final:", trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_final'] == -999].shape[0])

# Check how many patients have -999 in baseline and their response status
sentinel_baseline = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]
print("Response rate among those with sentinel baseline:", sentinel_baseline['responded'].mean())"}
